title: The High School Desert
description: Percentage of Italian municipalities completely devoid of high schools.

title: The Vocational Trap
description: Municipalities offering ONLY vocational schools, denying access to Lyceums.

title: Population Freefall
description: Projected drop in the 6-18 student population by 2035.

title: Missing Students
description: Absolute number of students projected to disappear from the system by 2035.

title: School Closures
description: Projected number of school closures by 2035 due to demographic winter.

title: Metropolitan Poverty Trap
description: NEET rate in Dense Urban Areas, paradoxically higher than rural zones.

title: Rural Resilience
description: NEET rate in Rural Areas, which show stronger community retention.

title: Urban Early Leavers
description: School dropout rate (early leavers) in major cities.

title: Urban Youth Unemployment
description: Youth unemployment rate in Italian metropolitan hubs.

title: The Southern Fracture
description: Peak NEET rate recorded in Sicily, representing the Southern collapse.

title: The Northern Shield
description: Lowest NEET rate in Italy (Trentino), comparable to Germany.

title: Lacking Habitability
description: Percentage of Italian schools operating without basic habitability certificates.

title: Seismic Danger
description: Schools lacking seismic safety verifications in a highly tectonic country.

title: Architectural Barriers
description: Schools that still have architectural barriers, blocking disabled access.

title: The Digital Divide
description: Schools disconnected from High-Speed 1Gbps Broadband.

title: Missing STEM Labs
description: Schools lacking active STEM laboratories, hurting technical skills.

title: Southern Seismic Risk
description: Shocking lack of seismic safety verifications in Sicilian schools.

title: Northern Seismic Risk
description: Even in wealthy Lombardy, seismic safety is widely uncertified.

title: Structural Decay Correlation
description: Pearson correlation coefficient between structural decay and NEET rates.

title: School Age
description: The median age of public school buildings in Italy.

title: The Precarity Crisis
description: Percentage of Italian teachers on temporary, precarious contracts.

title: Substitute Teachers
description: Sample size of substitute teachers vs 3,292 tenured.

title: Abandonment of Vulnerable
description: Percentage of Special Needs (Sostegno) teachers who are substitutes.

title: Substitute Sostegno
description: Raw number of substitute Sostegno teachers denying continuity to disabled kids.

title: Aging Workforce
description: Percentage of teachers over the age of 50 in Italy.

title: Young Teachers Missing
description: Abysmal percentage of teachers under the age of 30.

title: The Psychological Toll
description: Youth suicide mortality rate per 100,000.

title: EU Psychological Average
description: EU average suicide mortality rate, showing Italy's family protection buffer.

title: Brain Drain
description: Estimated percentage of university graduates emigrating abroad annually.

title: Job Mismatch
description: Graduates working in roles not requiring their degree (Overeducation).

title: Learning Poverty
description: Percentage of 10-year-olds who cannot read and understand simple text.

title: Liceo INVALSI
description: Standardized RAV score (out of 7) for Lyceums.

title: Professionale INVALSI
description: Standardized RAV score for Vocational schools, showing Cognitive Collapse.

title: PISA Math Score 2022
description: Italy's latest PISA math score, deeply below the OECD average.

title: PISA Math Collapse
description: Points lost in PISA Math proficiency between 2003 and 2022.

title: PISA Reading 2022
description: Italy's reading proficiency, heavily correlated with Learning Poverty.

title: Implicit Dispersione
description: Students who graduate but lack basic foundational competencies.

title: Early School Leavers
description: National average of students dropping out before a diploma.

title: Southern Early Leavers
description: Dropout rate specifically in Southern Italy (Mezzogiorno).

title: Curriculum Rigidity
description: Unlike comprehensive systems, Italy locks students into rigid tracks at age 14.

title: The Hidden Tax Median
description: Median textbook cost for the 1st year of High School.

title: The Hidden Tax Average
description: Average textbook cost, severely restricting low-income access.

title: Illegal Costs
description: Percentage of classes exceeding the State-mandated maximum cost threshold of €250.

title: Institutional Abandonment
description: Italy's total public spending on education as % of GDP.

title: The German Benchmark
description: Germany's spending on education, vastly outpacing Italy.

title: Tertiary Push
description: Gross enrollment ratio in Universities.

title: Tertiary Starvation
description: Tertiary spending per capita vs GDP, lowest among major peers.

title: ITS Academy Employment
description: Employment rate 1 year after graduation from ITS Academy (Dual System).

title: University Employment
description: Employment rate 1 year after graduation from University.

title: The DACH Paradox
description: Employment premium of ITS Academy over standard University degrees.

title: Science PISA 2022
description: Italy's PISA Science score, showing widespread scientific illiteracy.

title: Science PISA Collapse
description: Drop in PISA science scores between 2012 and 2022.

title: Active STEM Labs
description: Percentage of schools with active STEM labs.

title: Connected to 1Gbps
description: Percentage of schools successfully connected to high speed broadband.

title: GDP Per Capita Italy
description: Italy's GDP per capita, illustrating the economic stagnation driving the crisis.

title: GDP Per Capita EU
description: EU average GDP per capita, vastly outpacing Italy over the last two decades.

title: Avg Commute Time
description: Average commuting time for students due to school distribution.

title: Brain Drain Exodus
description: Youths emigrating annually due to the collapsed system.

title: Youth Inactivity
description: Rate of young adults entirely inactive (neither seeking nor in education).
